examples.label: research_paper
examples.text: We examine whether short daily walks improve working memory in older adults. Sixty volunteers were randomly assigned to a walking group or a stretching control group for twelve weeks. Memory scores improved more in the walking group (effect size d = 0.41). We discuss possible mechanisms and the need for larger trials.

examples.label: research_paper
examples.text: This work introduces a lightweight convolutional network for detecting crop disease from smartphone photos. Trained on 18,000 labelled leaf images, the model reaches 91% accuracy on an unseen test set. Compared with prior architectures it uses five times fewer parameters. Code and data are released to support reproducibility.

examples.label: research_paper
examples.text: Introduction. Coastal erosion threatens many small island communities. In this article we combine satellite imagery from 1990 to 2020 with interviews of local residents to quantify shoreline change. Our analysis indicates retreat rates of up to two metres per year. We conclude with implications for adaptation policy.
